selector_only_query_derivation.argument: Identity-query prefixes leave raw data maximally mixed, so each phase call changes a purification by <=2/sqrt(n!). Telescope q calls. Every hidden input is annihilated by all queried projectors, so its ancilla output equals the identity-query baseline.
selector_only_query_derivation.asymptotic_scope: Arbitrary K, arbitrary ancillary memory and coherent or deferred-classical ancilla control; no independence of successive actual queries is assumed.
selector_only_query_derivation.conclusion: T(output_null,output_h)<=min(1,2q/sqrt(n!)); if acceptance is zero on the ideal alternative, null acceptance <=min(1,4q^2/n!).
selector_only_query_derivation.exclusions: Arbitrary final data readout, data-dependent preprocessing/source labels, other data couplings and free postselection are not covered.

source_adaptive_query_audit.derivation: Frobenius reciprocity gives r_S<=1/d_j^2. E_Planch max_S r_S<=K p(n)/n!. The identity-prefix hybrid costs <=2q sqrt(K p(n)/n!), separately from source TV<=K/(2sqrt(M)).

source_adaptive_research_update: Source-adaptive extension derived/review-pending: T<=K/(2sqrt(M))+2q sqrt(K p(n)/n!). Central source labels do not rescue polynomial missing-sign query schedules; other carrier operations remain open.
summary: Retained-data missing-sign detector has constant bias without a minimum positive gap, but costs sqrt(n!) selected reflections. This is a costed benchmark, not a speedup.

theorem_contract.alternative_guarantee: P(report trivial|h)=0 ideally for EVERY promised h, not just the class average
theorem_contract.cost: O(poly(K,n,log(1/epsilon))*sqrt(n!)) gates, polynomial space; K states reused, not K fresh states per iteration
theorem_contract.detector: Half direct selected projection, half t uniform in [0,ceil(sqrt(n!))-1] two-reflection iterations
theorem_contract.frame: F=(2^K-1)^-1 sum_(S nonempty) Pi_sign^S, raw null I/(n!)^K
theorem_contract.input: K standard mixed coset states with the SAME hidden involution; retain all physical group data
theorem_contract.missing_harmonic: sign, with odd transposition count; fixed-point-free scaling requires n=2 mod 4
theorem_contract.nonclaims: No minimum-gap requirement for constant bias; no exact support compiler, general circuit lower bound, novelty, or speedup
theorem_contract.precision: O(T) primitive uses require operator error O(epsilon/T) each; poly(log T,log(1/epsilon)) synthesis overhead
theorem_contract.primitive: Coherently choose first selected pivot; compute x_i x_p^-1; reflect its uniform signed group state; uncompute
theorem_contract.schedule_upper_bound: For THIS mixed randomized schedule with T choices, raw-null acceptance <=min(1,(2T^2+1)/(3 n!))
